items.zh: 我钱包在地铁上被偷了，现在该找谁？
items.scene: 地铁站里，乘客向站务员求助

answers.en: My wallet was stolen on the subway. Who should I talk to?
answers.note: 先讲事实再问该找谁，语气平稳，适合刚发现、还没完全慌的时候。

answers.en: Someone stole my wallet on the subway — who do I report it to?
answers.note: 用 report 把报案说明白，语气比第一条急，适合确定要立案时。

answers.en: I think my wallet got stolen on the subway. Where do I go to report it?
answers.note: 加 I think 表示不确定，语气最软，适合还没弄清是被偷还是自己弄丢。

items.zh: 我手机在商场丢了，能帮我广播找一下吗？
items.scene: 商场服务台，顾客着急找手机

answers.en: I lost my phone somewhere in the mall. Could you make an announcement for me?
answers.note: 标准礼貌请求，could 开头，适合跟服务台正常沟通。

answers.en: My phone's gone — can you announce it over the PA?
answers.note: 口语化，gone 带出着急，直接假定对方能广播，适合语气急促时。

answers.en: My phone's missing. Could you make an announcement asking people to bring it to the front desk?
answers.note: 把广播内容说清楚，直接讲送到服务台，适合人多的大商场。

items.zh: 我包落出租车上了，怎么联系司机？
items.scene: 刚下出租车，发现包没拿

answers.en: I left my bag in a taxi. How do I get in touch with the driver?
answers.note: 中规中矩的问法，先说明落东西，再问怎么联系，适合打给出租车公司。

answers.en: My bag's still in the cab I just took — any way to reach the driver?
answers.note: 用 cab 更口语，still in 强调包还在车上，语气比第一条急。

answers.en: I think I left my bag in the taxi that just dropped me off. Is there a way to contact the driver?
answers.note: 最完整也最客气，先说明刚下车，适合需要对方帮忙查记录。

items.zh: 绕了三圈都没找到地铁口，到底往哪边走？
items.scene: 晚上在陌生街区，向路人问路

answers.en: I've walked around three times and still can't find the subway entrance — which way is it?
answers.note: 带点抱怨地讲自己绕了三圈，像跟朋友吐槽，适合对方看起来好说话。

answers.en: Excuse me, I'm trying to find the subway station. Could you point me in the right direction?
answers.note: 标准的陌生人开场，excuse me 加 could，最稳妥。

answers.en: Where's the nearest subway entrance? I keep missing it.
answers.note: 最短最直接，问完就走，适合赶时间或对方在忙。

items.zh: 护照在景区丢了，明天还要坐飞机，该找谁？
items.scene: 景区游玩时发现护照不见，到游客中心问工作人员

answers.en: I lost my passport somewhere around here. Who should I contact about it?
answers.note: 先说明丢了护照再问找谁，语气平稳，适合刚到服务中心。

answers.en: My passport is gone and I fly out tomorrow — should I go to the police or the consulate?
answers.note: 把明天的航班说出来，让对方知道有多急，还主动问该找谁。

answers.en: I can't find my passport anywhere. What's the fastest way to get a replacement?
answers.note: 不问找谁而问最快怎么补办，目标最明确，适合确认找不回来时。

items.zh: 导航把我带进小巷了，酒店到底在哪？
items.scene: 拖着行李箱在老城区找酒店，问路边摊主

answers.en: My GPS led me into this alley. Where exactly is the hotel?
answers.note: 带点烦躁，先怪导航再问酒店位置，适合跟摊主随口抱怨。

answers.en: I'm looking for my hotel — here's the address. Is it far from here?
answers.note: 直接递地址问远不远，最省事，适合手里有预订信息。

answers.en: Excuse me, could you help me find my hotel? The map app keeps sending me in circles.
answers.note: 最客气，先求助再解释导航绕圈，适合对方正忙着做生意。

items.zh: 我手机没电了，能借你手机打个电话吗？
items.scene: 街头手机没电，向路人借电话打给家人

answers.en: My phone died. Could I borrow yours for a quick call?
answers.note: could I borrow 很礼貌，加 a quick call 让对方放心不会打太久。

answers.en: Can I use your phone? Mine's dead and I need to call my family.
answers.note: 最直接，先说能不能用，再补理由，适合看起来好说话的年轻人。

answers.en: Sorry to bother you — my phone's dead. Would you mind if I made one quick call?
answers.note: 最客气，先道歉再请求，would you mind 适合跟年长者开口。

items.zh: 感觉有人一直跟着我，现在该怎么办？
items.scene: 晚上下班走小路，发现身后有人一直跟着

answers.en: I think someone's been following me for a few blocks. What should I do?
answers.note: 先讲跟了几条街再问怎么办，语气克制，适合还不想惊动对方。

answers.en: There's a guy behind me who won't leave me alone — where can I go to be around people?
answers.note: 用 won't leave me alone 说甩不掉，重点在找人多的地方，最实用。

answers.en: Someone's following me and I'm scared. Can I stay in your store until he's gone?
answers.note: 直接向店家开口求庇护，把害怕说出来，适合已经走到店门口。

items.zh: 楼上半夜还在装修，能报警吗？
items.scene: 凌晨被楼上电钻吵醒，问物业能不能报警

answers.en: My upstairs neighbor is drilling at midnight. Can I call the police?
answers.note: 直接问能不能报警，重点在确认这件事警察管不管。

answers.en: Is it worth calling the police about the noise upstairs? It's past midnight.
answers.note: 问 is it worth，带点犹豫，想先知道值不值得折腾。

answers.en: The drilling upstairs won't stop and it's after midnight — should I report it?
answers.note: 先讲经过再问该不该报，像在征求建议，语气最软。

items.zh: 电动车被偷了，报警还有用吗？
items.scene: 小区楼下发现电动车不见，问邻居

answers.en: My e-bike got stolen. Is it even worth reporting to the police?
answers.note: 加 even 带出怀疑，觉得报警可能没用，适合跟熟人吐槽。

answers.en: Someone stole my e-bike — should I file a police report?
answers.note: 最中性，file a police report 是标准说法，像在走流程。

answers.en: My e-bike's gone. Will the police actually do anything if I report it?
answers.note: 直接质疑警察会不会真管，情绪最强，适合又气又急时。

items.zh: 刚才有人抢我包，最近的派出所在哪？
items.scene: 晚上街头被抢，向便利店店员求助

answers.en: Someone just grabbed my bag. Where's the nearest police station?
answers.note: 陈述事实后直接问路，语气急但不失控，适合刚被抢。

answers.en: I was just robbed — where's the closest police station?
answers.note: 用 robbed 比 grabbed 重，情绪更强，适合惊魂未定的时候。

answers.en: My bag was snatched a minute ago. Could you tell me where the police station is?
answers.note: 最冷静，用 snatched 说清是抢包，还加 could you，适合尽量保持镇定。

items.zh: 有人晕倒了，这附近有医生吗？
items.scene: 地铁车厢里有人突然倒地，乘客大声求助

answers.en: Someone's passed out! Is there a doctor around?
answers.note: 喊出来的短句，passed out 最口语，适合车厢里立刻引起注意。

answers.en: This person just collapsed — is anyone here trained in first aid?
answers.note: 不问医生而问谁会急救，更实际，适合周围可能没人懂医。

answers.en: We need a doctor over here — someone has fainted!
answers.note: 像广播一样指出位置，over here 让人群知道该往哪去，语气最急。

items.zh: 孩子手被烫了，附近哪家医院能看急诊？
items.scene: 餐馆里孩子碰翻热汤，家长问店员

answers.en: My kid burned his hand — which hospital around here has an ER?
answers.note: 最直接，用 ER 这个美国常用说法，适合马上要答案。

answers.en: My son just spilled hot soup on his arm. How do we get to the closest emergency room?
answers.note: 先讲怎么烫的再问怎么去，细节多，适合跟店员解释。

answers.en: Could you help us find an emergency room? My child burned himself and we're not from here.
answers.note: 最客气，先求助再说明是外地人，适合对方还没反应过来时。

items.zh: 家里一股很重的煤气味，是不是该马上出去？
items.scene: 晚上回家一开门闻到浓重燃气味，站在门口打电话问朋友

answers.en: I just got home and the whole place smells like gas. Should I get out right now?
answers.note: 先描述气味再问要不要马上走，语气急但句子完整，适合站在门口。

answers.en: There's a strong gas smell in my apartment — who do I call, the gas company or 911?
answers.note: 直接问该打燃气公司还是 911，把选择摆出来，适合已经下楼。

answers.en: I think there's a gas leak — should I get everyone out and call the gas company?
answers.note: 把自己的判断说出来再求确认，像跟朋友核对，适合拿不准时。

items.zh: 我儿子不见了，刚才还在这的！
items.scene: 商场玩具区，妈妈发现孩子不见，抓住店员

answers.en: My son is missing — he was right here a second ago!
answers.note: 冲口而出的短句，先喊孩子不见了再补时间，最慌。

answers.en: I can't find my little boy. He was just here. Can you help me?
answers.note: 用 can't find 和 little boy，带哀求感，但比第一条稳住一点。

answers.en: Excuse me, my child is lost. Is there a lost and found or a security desk?
answers.note: 最冷静，直接问服务台或保安在哪，适合强迫自己镇定下来。

items.zh: 我爸出门两小时没回来，电话也不接，要报警吗？
items.scene: 父亲有轻度痴呆，家人问社区工作人员

answers.en: My dad's been gone for two hours and he's not answering his phone. Should I call the police?
answers.note: 直接问要不要报警，重点在找人，适合已经觉得不对劲。

answers.en: My father didn't come home and he's not picking up. Is it too early to report him missing?
answers.note: 问会不会太早，带犹豫，怕浪费警力或被说小题大做。

answers.en: I'm worried about my dad — he has dementia and hasn't come back. Would the police help if I called?
answers.note: 先讲痴呆再问警察管不管，信息最全，适合对方需要判断。

items.zh: 电梯卡在两层中间了，门也打不开，怎么求救？
items.scene: 小区电梯突然停住，人被关在里面，紧急按钮没人应

answers.en: The elevator's stuck between floors and the doors won't open. How do we get help?
answers.note: 先说卡住再说门打不开，信息清楚，适合按紧急按钮没人应时。

answers.en: We're stuck in the elevator! Can anyone out there hear us? Call the building manager!
answers.note: 隔门喊人，先确认外面有没有人，语气最急。

answers.en: The emergency button isn't working. Is there a maintenance number posted in here?
answers.note: 不喊不慌，先找轿厢里的维修电话，适合还能冷静观察时。

items.zh: 家里突然停电了，是整栋楼都停了吗？
items.scene: 晚上在家加班，灯突然灭了，打电话问物业

answers.en: My power just went out. Is the whole building out too?
answers.note: 最口语，went out 是日常说法，适合跟物业随口确认。

answers.en: The electricity in my apartment just cut out — is it a building-wide outage?
answers.note: 更正式，用 outage 和 building-wide，适合对方需要准确信息。

answers.en: Did everyone lose power, or is it just my unit?
answers.note: 把整栋和自家两种情况摆出来问，顺带打听邻居家。

items.zh: 停电一天了，冰箱里的东西还能吃吗？
items.scene: 小区停电超过一天，在楼道里问邻居

answers.en: The power's been out all day. Is the food in my fridge still safe to eat?
answers.note: 问得最谨慎，safe to eat 像在确认食品安全，适合不想浪费又怕吃坏。

answers.en: We've had no power for a day — do you think my fridge food's gone bad?
answers.note: 最随意，gone bad 很口语，适合跟熟人邻居聊。

answers.en: With the power out this long, should I just throw out everything in the fridge?
answers.note: 直接问要不要全扔，带点心疼，适合已经拿不定主意时。

items.zh: 楼上漏水漏到我家了，我该找谁说？
items.scene: 客厅天花板滴水，楼下住户打电话问物业

answers.en: Water's leaking from upstairs into my apartment. Who do I talk to about this?
answers.note: 平铺直叙，先讲漏水再问找谁，适合第一次打电话。

answers.en: My ceiling's dripping — the unit above me has a leak. Can you get someone to come up?
answers.note: 先描述天花板滴水再要求派人，更像催物业行动。

answers.en: There's water coming through my ceiling from upstairs. Is this something you handle, or do I call the landlord?
answers.note: 问清是物业管还是要找房东，适合不想被踢皮球。

items.zh: 厨房水管爆了，水关不住，怎么办？
items.scene: 深夜厨房水管爆裂，水漫一地，打给朋友

answers.en: My kitchen pipe burst and I can't shut the water off. What do I do?
answers.note: 最慌，先报爆管再问怎么办，适合第一时间求助。

answers.en: The water won't stop — a pipe burst under my sink. Who should I call?
answers.note: 说清水关不住再问该打给谁，比第一条多一步判断。

answers.en: Help — my kitchen's flooding. The pipe burst and the shutoff valve won't close.
answers.note: 像喊救命，flooding 和 valve 画面感强，情绪最急。

items.zh: 钥匙丢了进不了门，开锁师傅电话你有吗？
items.scene: 晚上回家发现钥匙不见，敲邻居的门

answers.en: I lost my keys and I'm locked out. Do you have a locksmith's number?
answers.note: 直接开口要电话，不绕弯，适合跟熟一点的邻居说。

answers.en: I can't get into my apartment — my keys are gone. Know any locksmiths around here?
answers.note: 用 know any 更随意，像聊天时顺口问，适合楼道里碰见。

answers.en: Would you happen to have a locksmith you'd recommend? I've locked myself out.
answers.note: 最客气，would you happen to 很委婉，适合跟不熟的邻居开口。

items.zh: 车钥匙锁车里了，叫拖车还是找开锁的？
items.scene: 停车场里钥匙落在座位上，车门锁了

answers.en: I locked my keys in the car. Should I call a locksmith or a tow truck?
answers.note: 把两个选项摆出来直接问，最省事，适合自己已经没主意。

answers.en: My keys are locked inside the car. What do people usually do here — call a locksmith?
answers.note: 问当地人通常怎么办，带点入乡随俗的意思，适合在陌生城市。

answers.en: My keys are locked in the car — is it cheaper to call a locksmith or just get it towed?
answers.note: 直接问哪种更省钱，带盘算，适合手头紧、想先算钱时。

items.zh: 有个外国人问我路，我一句英文都听不懂，怎么办？
items.scene: 街头被外国游客拦住问路，自己英语不好

answers.en: A tourist just asked me for directions and I couldn't understand a word. What do I do?
answers.note: 最慌，a word 强调一句都听不懂，适合当场愣住时。

answers.en: Someone asked me something in English and I froze. How do I tell them I don't speak English?
answers.note: 带自嘲，froze 说出当时的尴尬，重点在问怎么回绝。

answers.en: A foreigner stopped me for directions, but my English isn't good enough. Should I just use a translation app?
answers.note: 最冷静，想到用翻译软件，适合还能掏出手机的时候。

items.zh: 在医院看病，医生说的英文我听不懂，能找个翻译吗？
items.scene: 国外医院急诊，患者听不懂医嘱，问护士

answers.en: I don't understand what the doctor's saying. Is there an interpreter available?
answers.note: 直接要翻译，interpreter 是医院里的正式说法，适合跟护士说。

answers.en: Sorry, my English isn't great — could someone translate for me?
answers.note: 先道歉再请求，语气软，适合不想显得麻烦别人。

answers.en: Is there anyone here who speaks Chinese? I'm not following the doctor.
answers.note: 直接问有没有会中文的人，最实际，not following 说明跟不上。
